failure_semantics.input_error: Bad arguments, malformed JSON, missing required files/fields, unsupported schema, invalid hash format, path escape, symlink, or resource-limit violation; emit bounded input error and exit 2.
failure_semantics.internal_error: Unexpected implementation error; emit generic error record without traceback/source content and exit 3.
failure_semantics.pass: All required checks pass; emit status PASS and exit 0.
failure_semantics.validation_fail: Well-formed invocation but evidence fails one or more requirements; emit deterministic status FAIL and exit 1.

input_contract.evidence_root: Existing read-only directory containing manifest.json, sources/, interfaces/, fixtures/, and receipts/ as referenced by manifest. Root and every referenced file must resolve beneath evidence root; symlinks rejected.

observations: The local ai-hub-status wrapper exposes a fixed read-only operation set and validated project slugs.
The VPS status helper has a stable outer envelope; canonical Controller receipt result schemas are not included in the inspected source and remain opaque.
The managed VPS package exposes exactly eight read-only tools with schemas recorded here.
No live Controller query, project mutation, lifecycle action, or GPU allocation was performed.

lineage_statement: New v2 implementation only; not source-equivalent to v1. V1 source, image identity, and criteria are not reused or reconstructed.
open_requirements: Canonical Controller receipt payload schema remains outside v2 validation scope until an authoritative schema is published.

output_contract.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, one newline; deterministic for identical input bytes and source_commit argument. No timestamp or raw source/fixture payloads.
output_contract.reason: stable machine-readable reason code, no secret values

scope_contract.purpose: Offline validator of captured source/interface evidence and sanitized status/receipt fixtures. It checks the published read-only wrapper envelope and current managed tool schemas; it does not query Controller, invoke SSH, allocate GPU, mutate lifecycle state, or claim semantics for opaque canonical Controller receipt payloads.

sufficiency.qualification: The validator checks the stable status envelope and treats nested canonical Controller receipt results as opaque JSON because their internal schema is not in inspected source; the local CLI does not expose the helper-only receipt verbs. It validates four validator infrastructure receipt types using policy-required fields and explicit v2 version/type design choices where the policy is silent. Build-contract readiness means the v2 validator behavior and acceptance are specified; it does not authorize or perform implementation, image build, publication, archive upload, or Controller actions.
